knowledge_sources.label: About Fernweh Supply Co.
knowledge_sources.content:
Fernweh Supply Co.. Small-batch gear for the long way round.
Fernweh Supply Co. — a real WooCommerce shop with a live catalogue, a signed-in customer, real orders and an open REST API to drive it all.
A small travel-gear workshop in Leipzig, Germany, selling in euros. Website: https://woo.demo.busymate.ai/. Fernweh Supply Co. is an INVENTED brand used to demonstrate Busymate AI on a real WooCommerce store: no order is fulfilled, no payment is taken, and the customer behind the sign-in card is not a real person. Tell anyone who is about to enter real personal or payment data not to.

knowledge_sources.label: Where the catalogue comes from
knowledge_sources.content: Fernweh Supply Co. sells 14 products across Merino Layers, Bottles & Flasks, Notebooks & Paper, Packs & Bags. The catalogue is NOT in this text: it is read live from the shop's own WooCommerce store — the connected store source for the product pages, and the store's MCP tools (search_products, get_product) for a price, a stock count or a specification right now. When a shopper asks what is available, what something costs, what it is made of or whether it is in stock, CALL a tool; never answer a catalogue question from memory, and never quote a number this text does not contain.

knowledge_sources.label: Delivery, cost and transit times
knowledge_sources.content:
Everything is packed and sent from our own workshop in Leipzig. There is no third-party fulfilment, which is why we can tell you exactly where an order is.

## When it leaves us

Orders placed before 13:00 CET on a working day go out the same afternoon. Anything after that, or at a weekend, goes the next working day. We do not ship on German public holidays, and the one week a year the workshop closes is announced on this page a month ahead.

## What it costs and how long it takes

| Destination | Cost | Typical transit | Free over |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Germany | €4.90 | 1–2 working days | €120 |
| European Union | €9.90 | 2–5 working days | €180 |
| United Kingdom & Switzerland | €14.90 | 3–7 working days | €250 |
| Rest of world | €24.90 | 7–21 working days | — |

## Duties and taxes

EU prices include German VAT at 19%. Orders to the United Kingdom, Switzerland and the rest of the world are sent excluding VAT, and the carrier will collect import duty and local tax before delivery. We cannot estimate that figure for you and we do not mark parcels as gifts.

## Tracking

Every parcel is tracked. The tracking number reaches you by email the moment the label is scanned, not when it is printed — so if you have the number, the parcel is genuinely on its way. If tracking has not moved for four working days, write to us and we will chase the carrier rather than asking you to.

## If something goes missing

We treat a parcel as lost after 10 working days domestically and 30 internationally, and we replace it at our cost without asking you to open a claim with the carrier. That is our problem, not yours.

Full page: https://woo.demo.busymate.ai/shipping/

knowledge_sources.label: Returns and repairs
knowledge_sources.content:
You have 60 days from delivery to send anything back, for any reason or none. That is longer than the 14 days EU law requires, and the extra days are ours, not a legal obligation — your statutory right of withdrawal is described at the bottom of this page and is unaffected by anything above it.

## How to send something back

- Write to [hallo@fernweh.example](mailto:hallo@fernweh.example) with your order number, or ask in the chat on this site.
- We email a prepaid label for Germany and the EU. Elsewhere we refund the return postage once the parcel arrives.
- Refunds go back to the original payment method within three working days of the parcel reaching us. Cards take a further two to five days to show it.

## What we can take back

Unworn, unwashed items in resaleable condition, with tags where they had them. Merino that has been worn once is fine — we would rather you tried it than guessed. Underwear and socks that have been worn are not, for reasons that need no explanation. Sale items return at the price you paid.

## Repairs

We repair anything we made, for as long as we can get the parts, and for the first three years we do it free including postage. After that it is charged at cost — typically €15 to €40 for a zip, a strap or a re-stitch — and we tell you the price before we start. Send a photograph first; half of what people ask about turns out to be a five-minute fix they can do at home, and we will say so.

## Guarantee

Three years against manufacturing fault, from the delivery date, on everything except the ink and the paper refills. A fault is a seam, a zip, a weld or a coating that failed doing what the product is for. Wear is not a fault, and neither is a bag that was overloaded past its rating.

## Your statutory right of withdrawal

As a consumer in the EU you may withdraw from this contract within 14 days of receiving the goods without giving any reason. To do so, tell us in a clear statement — an email is enough. We will refund all payments received, including standard outbound delivery, within 14 days of being told. We may withhold the refund until the goods are back with us.

Full page: https://woo.demo.busymate.ai/returns/

knowledge_sources.label: Privacy
knowledge_sources.content:
This is a demonstration store. It is not a real trading company, and you should not enter real personal data into it. Everything below describes how the demo behaves, honestly, so that it is a useful example of a privacy page rather than a placeholder.

## What this site stores

- **Order data** — the name, address and email attached to an order, the items and the amount. Held in this store's own database on its own isolated volume.
- **Account data** — if you sign in as the provided demo customer, your session cookie and the order history attached to that account.
- **Technical logs** — request paths and timestamps, kept for seven days for operational reasons and then deleted.

## What it does not store

No payment details ever reach this store: the demo does not take real payments and has no card processor attached. There are no advertising trackers, no analytics pixels and no third-party scripts that profile you. Nothing is sold, shared or transferred to anyone.

## The assistant

If you use the chat on this site, your messages are processed to answer them and to call the store's own tools on your behalf — looking up an order, checking stock. Ask the assistant to hand you to a person and it will stop and do that instead.

## Your rights

Under the GDPR you may ask for a copy of your data, ask for it to be corrected, or ask for it to be deleted, and we act on that within 30 days. For this demo, the fastest route is to ask in the chat, or write to [privacy@fernweh.example](mailto:privacy@fernweh.example).

## Cookies

Two: a session cookie that keeps your cart between pages, and one that remembers you dismissed the cookie notice. Both expire when you close the browser or within 30 days. There is no third-party cookie on this site at all.

Full page: https://woo.demo.busymate.ai/privacy/

knowledge_sources.label: Terms
knowledge_sources.content:
**Fernweh Supply Co. is an invented brand, created to demonstrate a working online shop.** No goods are really dispatched, no payment is really taken, and no contract of sale is formed by anything you do here. These terms are written as a real shop's terms would be, because a demo with lorem ipsum in it teaches nobody anything.

## Prices

Prices are in euro and include German VAT at 19% for orders inside the EU. Orders outside the EU are charged without VAT and are subject to import duty in the destination country. We may change a price at any time, but never after an order is placed.

## Orders

An order is an offer to buy. The contract is formed when we send the dispatch confirmation, not when the order confirmation lands — so if something sells out between the two, we cancel and refund in full rather than making you wait. Stock figures on a product page are live to within a minute.

## Availability

Everything on this site is made in batches. When a batch runs out, the product page says so and gives the date the next one is expected; that date is our honest estimate and it slips sometimes. We do not take payment for a backorder until the batch is in the building.

## Liability

We are liable for the goods being as described and fit for their purpose, and for anything the law does not permit us to limit. We are not liable for a trip that went badly. Nothing here affects your statutory rights as a consumer.

## Governing law

German law, with the courts of Leipzig having jurisdiction, and without affecting any mandatory consumer protection you have where you live.

## Contact

Fernweh Supply Co. (demonstration), Hainstrasse 14, 04103 Leipzig. Written enquiries to [hallo@fernweh.example](mailto:hallo@fernweh.example).

Full page: https://woo.demo.busymate.ai/terms/

knowledge_sources.label: The provided demo customer
knowledge_sources.content: One throwaway demo customer is provided so the identified experience can be tested without a real account: Mara Oertel, a customer of this shop, with five orders in five different states — one being packed, one completed, one refunded, one cancelled and one on hold. Order details, returns and the order history are only ever given to that customer once this chat can see who is asking.

knowledge_sources.label: Signing in
knowledge_sources.content: Most of what a visitor asks for needs NO sign-in: the range, prices, stock, delivery costs, returns, privacy and terms all answer for an anonymous visitor, and asking them to sign in first for any of those is wrong. Only the order book — where is my order, what have I ordered, starting a return — needs to know who is asking. For those, just TRY the order tool. When this chat cannot see who is asking yet, a sign-in card appears in the conversation on its own and the answer follows once they use it. Signing in is one click, there is no password, and it returns them to this same conversation as the demo customer. NEVER describe a control or where it is: do not say "the button at the top", do not point at a header, the storefront or an account page, and do not list ways to sign in — the card comes to them and is the only path you offer. Say ONE short line ("You will need to be signed in for that — here you go") and stop.

knowledge_sources.label: How to ask for details
knowledge_sources.content:
When something is missing — an order number, which item is going back, why — do NOT write the question out as a paragraph or a list for the customer to type answers to. CALL the tool anyway, with whatever is already known and nothing else: get_order_status with no order number, start_return with only what was said. The tool answers with its own card in the chat — labelled fields and a submit button — the customer fills that in, and the tool then runs for real. One short line of context before it is plenty; never enumerate the fields in prose as well.
NEVER PUT UP A FORM FOR SOMETHING ALREADY SAID. If the message already names the order and the item — "open a return for the Quelle 750 on order 53" — call start_return with them THERE AND THEN. A form that asks again for what was just typed reads as not having listened, and an EMPTY form when every answer is already on screen is the worst version of it. A form is for what is genuinely missing, and only for that.
THE MOMENT A FORM COMES BACK FILLED IN, CALL THE TOOL WITH WHAT IT SAID. A message that begins "Start the return — here are the details" is not the end of the job, it is the arguments for start_return: call start_return(orderNumber, item, reason) with them, right then, and say nothing about the outcome until the result is back. Do not put a second form in the conversation, do not ask the same three things again under a different heading, and do not summarise the answers back as though something happened.
A FORM IS NOT AN OUTCOME. Collecting answers changes nothing on its own: a return exists only once start_return has RUN and come back with a reference beginning RMA-, and an order's state is only what get_order_status just returned. Once details are in hand, call the tool and report what IT said. Never tell a customer a return is open, a label is coming, or a parcel is on its way unless a tool result in this conversation says so — on this shop nothing is dispatched anyway, so an invented confirmation is the one answer that is simply false.
get_product needs a SKU or a product name. If neither has been said, use search_products instead; calling get_product with nothing puts an empty box in the conversation and asks the customer to do the assistant's work.

knowledge_sources.label: What this demonstration shows
knowledge_sources.content: This shop is the WooCommerce demo on the Busymate AI playground. It demonstrates, and can be asked about: answers grounded in this store's own pages; six of the page's own actions published over WebMCP (search, read the cart, add an item, remove one, open a product, who is signed in); the store's own MCP server at https://woo.demo.busymate.ai/mcp with three public tools and three that answer only for an identified customer; the identity handoff, both halves, signed by the store's own key; action cards for a return and an order lookup; and hand-off to a person, which queues the conversation to the workspace Inbox. Every one of those is explained in a block on the shop's front page, each with a line to try and a link to the guide for doing the same on a real store.
